features.title: Cargo workspace and crate graph
features.scope: Workspace with the crates in ARCHITECTURE.md, feature flags, CI on macOS/Linux, pinned MSRV, license notices.

features.title: Core IDs, errors and diagnostics
features.scope: Newtypes for buffer/window/tab/script IDs; `VimError` with `E###` codes, message text and throwpoint; no panics across API boundaries.

features.title: Event loop and redraw scheduler
features.scope: Single-threaded scheduler for input, timers, job events, screen resize and deferred redraw; nearest-deadline waits; no busy loop.

features.title: Registries for commands/options/functions/events
features.scope: One metadata table per surface: name, abbreviation, arity, flags, feature gate, doc tag, handler. Drives parsing, completion, `:help` and the inventory audit.

features.title: Editor state ownership and arenas
features.scope: `Editor` owns buffers, windows, tab pages, scripts, registers, marks and global variables; slotmap/indexmap arenas, explicit borrow-splitting for render.

features.title: Headless driver and golden frames
features.scope: Scriptable editor driver: feed keys, run Ex, inspect model, snapshot Frame; used by every subsystem test.

features.title: Platform abstraction
features.scope: Filesystem, process spawn, PTY, signals, terminal size, clipboard, locale, environment; Unix first, Windows behind the same traits.

features.title: Benchmark and fuzz harness
features.scope: Criterion-style benchmarks for startup, frame render, regex, syntax and large files; cargo-fuzz targets for parsers and input.

features.title: CLI and startup orchestrator
features.scope: Args (`-c`, `-S`, `-u`, `--clean`, `-p`, `-o`, `-O`, `-R`, `-r`, `--headless`, `--stdio-channel` handoff), init order, `--startuptime`, exit codes; `--headless` is an RVim extension.

features.title: Tracing and verbose diagnostics
features.scope: Category-based logs (`input`, `ex`, `viml`, `render`, `runtime`, `job`, `js`), `'verbose'` levels, `:verbose` source tracing, crash report.

features.title: Option registry and typed values
features.scope: All Vim 9.2.1338 options with type, scope, default, flags, validator, short name and doc tag; boolean/number/string with typed storage, not stringly-typed; feature-gated options report availability honestly.

features.title: `:set` parser, flags and abbreviations
features.scope: `set`/`setlocal`/`setglobal`, `?`, `&`, `&vim`, `!`, `inv`, `no`, `+=`/`-=`/`^=`, `<` reset, `all`, unambiguous abbreviations.

features.title: Scopes, inheritance and global-local options
features.scope: Global, buffer, window and tab scopes; global-local options (`'statusline'`, `'errorformat'`, `'tags'`); `:setlocal` fallback semantics; option <-> window ownership.

features.title: Option access from VimL
features.scope: `&opt`, `&l:opt`, `&g:opt`, `setbufvar()`/`setwinvar()` option keys, `getbufvar()` readback, option reset rules.

features.title: Defaults and reset semantics
features.scope: Vim defaults (not Vi), `&vim`/`all&`, `--clean`, `-u DEFAULTS`, exclusion of `'compatible'` behavior, startup option files.

features.title: Modelines
features.scope: `'modeline'`/`'modelines'`/`'modelinestrict'` parsing, first/last N lines, safe-option allowlist, secure filtering, OptionSet side effects and tests.

features.title: TTY and `t_*` options
features.scope: `:set termcap`, `t_Co`/`t_AB`-style key codes bridged to the TUI key table; capability reporting; never let UI code own Vim option semantics.

features.title: `:options` window
features.scope: `optwin.vim` compatibility: synthetic buffer, per-option jump tags, toggling and `:set` round-trip.

features.title: OptionSet event and side effects
features.scope: Fire `OptionSet` with `v:option_*`, apply side effects (wrap, numberwidth, syntax, filetype, foldmethod), avoid recursive set storms.

features.title: Line buffer and byte indexing
features.scope: Stable line IDs, byte-indexed access, NUL/NL fidelity, `changedtick`, O(log n) line insert/delete via chunked line tree, O(1) line count.

features.title: Buffer list and lifecycle
features.scope: Listed/unlisted, loaded/unloaded, hidden, `:badd`/`:bufadd`/`:bufload`/`:bdelete`/`:bwipeout`, alternate buffer `#`, `CTRL-^`/`CTRL-6`, `BufAdd/BufDelete/BufUnload` events.

features.title: File read/write core
features.scope: `:edit`/`:write`/`:read`, address ranges, `:write !cmd`, `:read !cmd`, filters, permissions, `'writeany'`, partial writes, errors without data loss.

features.title: File format, EOL and BOM
features.scope: `'fileformat'` unix/dos/mac, `'fileformats'` detection, `'endofline'`, `'fixendofline'`, `'bomb'`, mixed-EOL reporting, byte-exact rewrite.

features.title: File encodings and iconv
features.scope: `'fileencoding'`, `'fileencodings'` probe order, BOM/UTF-16, iconv fallback, `:scriptencoding`; internal encoding is UTF-8 only.

features.title: Backup, swap and recovery
features.scope: `'backup'`/`'writebackup'`/`'backupcopy'`/`'backupskip'`, swap file naming/permissions/`'updatetime'`, `:preserve`, `:recover`, `-r`, `v:swapchoice`.

features.title: Marks, jumplist, changelist
features.scope: `a-z`/`A-Z`/`0-9` marks, special marks `'` `.` `^` `[` `]` `<` `>`, mark adjustment on edits, jumplist `<C-o>/<C-i>`, changelist `g;/g,`, `getmarklist()`.

features.title: Buffer-local variables and options
features.scope: `b:` variables, buffer options, `b:changedtick`, `getbufvar()`/`setbufvar()`, `:let b:...`; lifetime tied to buffer wipe.

features.title: Special buffer types
features.scope: `'buftype'` nofile/nowrite/acwrite/quickfix/help/prompt, `'bufhidden'`, `'swapfile'`, `'modifiable'`/`'readonly'` enforcement and plugin hooks.

features.title: Argument list
features.scope: Local/global arglists, `:args`/`:next`/`:prev`/`:rewind`/`:argument`/`:argadd`/`:argdelete`, `argadd()`/`argv()`, `:argdo`.

features.title: Working directory and path handling
features.scope: `:cd`/`:lcd`/`:tcd`/`:pwd`, `'autochdir'`, `'path'`, `findfile()`/`finddir()`, `DirChanged` events, filename modifiers and escaping.

features.title: File-changed detection
features.scope: `'autoread'`, `:checktime`, `FileChangedShell`/`FileChangedShellPost`, timestamp/size checks, dialog and `v:swapchoice` handling.

features.title: Large files and binary mode
features.scope: `-b`, `'binary'`, `'maxmem'`-style limits, memory-mapped/paged line store option, huge-line handling, no quadratically slow edits.

features.title: Sessions and views
features.scope: `:mksession`/`:mkview`/`:loadview`, `'sessionoptions'`/`'viewoptions'`, `SessionLoadPre`, window layout, folds, marks and local options, `v:this_session`.

features.title: Viminfo and Shada
features.scope: `'viminfo'`/`'shada'` parsing, history/registers/marks/`'0`-`'9`/oldfiles persistence, `:rviminfo`/`:wviminfo`, locking and corruption handling.

features.title: Buffer text listeners
features.scope: `listener_add()`/`listener_remove()`, change notifications with start/end/added/touched, callback safety and reentrancy guards.

features.title: File identity, permissions and `:saveas`
features.scope: `:file`/`:saveas`, read-only file handling, ownership/mode preservation, `'readonly'` override with `!`.

features.title: Undo tree and undo blocks
features.scope: Branching undo tree, sequence numbers, time stamps, block boundaries for insert/operator/Ex edits, `'undolevels'` pruning, `undotree()` data.

features.title: `u`/`<C-r>` and counts
features.scope: Counted undo/redo, cursor restore, `'undolevels'` negative/zero special cases, message reporting.

features.title: Ex undo navigation
features.scope: `:undo`, `:redo`, `:earlier`/`:later` with counts and time units (`s`, `m`, `h`, `d`, `f`), `g-`/`g+`.

features.title: `:undojoin` and undo state APIs
features.scope: `:undojoin`, `undojoin` from VimL, cursor/visual state restore, `undotree()`, `wundo()`/`rundo()` entry points.

features.title: Persistent undo
features.scope: `'undofile'`/`'undodir'`, `:wundo`/`:rundo`, Vim-compatible undo file format (versioned), permissions and cleanup.

features.title: Undo across reload and `'undoreload'`
features.scope: Preserve undo when rereading unchanged files, `'undoreload'` limit, `:e!` semantics, stale undo detection.

features.title: Split tree, layout and sizes
features.scope: Frame tree of horizontal/vertical splits, min sizes, `'equalalways'`/`'eadirection'`, resize propagation, deterministic geometry for tests.

features.title: Viewport, cursor and scroll state
features.scope: Per-window `topline`/`leftcol`/`skipcol`/`curswant`, independent cursors for one buffer, scrolloff, cursor clamping, `winsaveview()`/`winrestview()`.

features.title: Window-local options and variables
features.scope: `w:` variables, window options (`'number'`, `'wrap'`, `'foldmethod'`, `'signcolumn'`...), inheritance on split and `:setlocal`.

features.title: Window commands and `:wincmd`
features.scope: `:split`/`:vsplit`/`:new`/`:vnew`/`:close`/`:only`/`:hide`/`:quit`/`:resize`/`:vertical resize`, `CTRL-W` command matrix, `:wincmd`.

features.title: Window focus, movement and constraints
features.scope: `CTRL-W h/j/k/l/w/W/t/b/p`, `:wincmd`, `'winminheight'`/`'winminwidth'`, focus follows close, alternate window, `WinEnter`/`WinLeave`.

features.title: Preview window
features.scope: `:pedit`/`:pclose`/`:ppop`, `'previewheight'`, one preview per tab, tag/help preview integration, `CTRL-W z`.

features.title: Window IDs and scripting APIs
features.scope: `win_getid()`/`win_id2win()`/`win_findbuf()`/`winlayout()`/`win_execute()`/`winrestcmd()`, stable IDs across reordering.

features.title: Scrolling options and synchronized views
features.scope: `'scroll'`, `'scrolloff'`/`'scrolloffpad'`/`'sidescrolloff'`, `'scrollbind'`/`'cursorbind'`/`'scrollopt'`, `CTRL-E/Y/D/U/F/B`, `zz/zt/zb`, `'smoothscroll'`.

features.title: Window size constraints
features.scope: `'winfixheight'`/`'winfixwidth'`/`'winfixbuf'`, `'winheight'`/`'winwidth'`, `:resize` with counts, `win_move_separator()`/`win_move_statusline()`.

features.title: Window decorations and separators
features.scope: Window separators, statusline rows (height supplied by the statusline widget), border/click regions, correct width accounting, resize repaint; gutters are DSP-10.

features.title: Mouse separator and statusline drag
features.scope: Hit regions on separators/statusline, drag resize, double-click equalize, `'mouse'` gating, no UI-specific geometry in the model.

features.title: Global statusline and `'laststatus'`
features.scope: `'laststatus'` 0/1/2/3, global statusline, statusline cache invalidation on window/buffer changes.

features.title: Tab-page model
features.scope: Ordered tab pages, each with a window tree and current window; tab-local variables/options; closing the last window closes the tab.

features.title: Tab commands and navigation
features.scope: `:tabnew`/`:tabedit`/`:tabclose`/`:tabonly`/`:tabmove`/`:tabnext`/`:tabprevious`/`:tabfirst`/`:tablast`, `gt`/`gT`/`<C-PageUp>`, counts.

features.title: `'showtabline'` and tabline integration
features.scope: 0/1/2 modes, tabline row ownership, minimum one tab, resize interaction, tabline hidden when appropriate.

features.title: Tab-local scope and APIs
features.scope: `t:` variables, tab options, `gettabvar()`/`settabvar()`, `gettabinfo()`, `tabpagenr()`/`tabpagebuflist()`/`tabpagewinnr()`.

features.title: `'tabline'` expression and clicks
features.scope: Evaluate `'tabline'`, `%1T` clickable labels, close buttons `%X`, highlighting, `'guitablabel'`/`'guitabtooltip'` stored for future GUI.

features.title: Tab lifecycle events and IDs
features.scope: Stable tabpage IDs, `TabNew`/`TabEnter`/`TabLeave`/`TabClosed`, `:tabclose` with modified buffers, `:tabonly` confirmation.

features.title: Session and tab restoration
features.scope: `:mksession` tab order, current tab, per-tab window layout, tab-local options and working directories.

features.title: Tabpanel sidebar and API
features.scope: `'showtabpanel'` 0/1/2, `'tabpanel'`/`'tabpanelopt'` (`columns`, `align`, `vert`, `scrollbar`), vertical sidebar layout, `TabPanel`/`TabPanelSel`/`TabPanelFill`, wheel/drag scrolling, `tabpanel_getinfo()`/`tabpanel_scroll()`, `:redrawtabpanel`, backend-neutral cells and hit regions.

features.title: Cell, grid, frame and attribute model
features.scope: Backend-neutral `Frame` with grids, `Cell` (grapheme cluster + attr id), `Attr` (fg/bg/sp, bold, italic, underline/curl/double/dotted/dashed, strike, reverse, blink, conceal), cursor and metadata.

features.title: `UiBackend` trait and capabilities
features.scope: Lifecycle trait: init, present, poll event, resize, title, clipboard, suspend/resume, shutdown; capability negotiation for color depth, mouse, paste, focus, kitty keyboard, synchronized output, in-band resize, IME, pixel metrics and images.

features.title: Compositor
features.scope: Layer stack (base, popups, external overlays), z-order, clipping, dirty rectangles/rows, cursor occlusion, frame sequence numbers and diff-friendly output.

features.title: Hit regions and mouse routing
features.scope: Core registers clickable/draggable regions with semantic `ActionId` (window border, statusline item, tab, sign, fold, popup item); backends send coordinates only.

features.title: TUI backend
features.scope: Raw mode, alternate screen, terminfo/termcap lookup, `SIGWINCH` resize, `'termresize'` in-band resize, `'termsync'` synchronized output, title, bell, cursor shape, panic-safe terminal restore, `:set t_*` bridge.

features.title: TTY input decoding
features.scope: Function/arrow keys, modifiers, xterm/SGR/urxvt/X10 mouse, bracketed paste, focus events, `modifyOtherKeys` and kitty keyboard protocol; documented ESC/Alt ambiguity policy tied to `'ttimeoutlen'`.

features.title: Color negotiation and fallback
features.scope: Mono/16/256/truecolor, `t_Co`, `'termguicolors'`, nearest-color mapping for cterm, GUI truecolor path, stable `AttrId` palette per frame.

features.title: Cursor, focus and paste events
features.scope: Cursor style per mode, blink policy, focus in/out, bracketed-paste payloads, `'paste'` handoff, kitty key release/repeat filtering.

features.title: Suspend, resume and signals
features.scope: `SIGTSTP`/`SIGCONT`/`SIGINT`/`SIGTERM`, `:stop`/`:suspend`, terminal state save/restore around shell commands, `VimSuspend`/`VimResume`.

features.title: Clipboard providers
features.scope: macOS `pbcopy/pbpaste`, Wayland `wl-copy/wl-paste`, X11 `xclip/xsel`, optional OSC 52; core owns `'clipboard'`/registers, provider only moves bytes.

features.title: GUI extension contract
features.scope: Documented optional traits for pixel metrics, IME preedit, native menus, scrollbars, tab drag, fonts/ligatures and decorations. No GUI implementation in this project phase.

features.title: Headless snapshot backend
features.scope: Deterministic 80x24 (configurable) cell dump, JSON snapshots, `screenchar()`-style inspection, diffable frames for CI.

features.title: Screen introspection functions
features.scope: `screenchar()`/`screenchars()`/`screenstring()`/`screenpos()`/`screenattr()`/`screencol()`/`screenrow()`/`getbgcolor()`, cell-width aware.

features.title: Redraw control
features.scope: `:redraw`/`:redraw!`, `'lazyredraw'`, `'redrawtime'`, partial updates, message/flush ordering, no flicker on large frames.

features.title: Redraw listeners
features.scope: `redraw_listener_add()`/`redraw_listener_remove()`, `on_start`/`on_end` Funcref callbacks, listener IDs, main-thread ordering, sandbox and reentrancy errors, callbacks cannot trigger recursive redraw.

features.title: Statusline layout engine
features.scope: Left/center/right groups (`%=`), truncation (`%<`), minimum widths, highlight run merging, wide-character width, click region capture.

features.title: Statusline item expansion
features.scope: `%f %F %t %m %M %r %R %h %H %w %W %y %Y %l %L %c %C %v %V %o %O %p %P %a %{...} %#hl# %1* %0* %= %< %%%`, `%[FuncName]`/`%[]` click regions, `%@` newline and modifier flags.

features.title: Statusline expression evaluation and caching
features.scope: Evaluate `'statusline'` per window with `g:statusline_winid`, sandbox errors into messages, cache by buffer/window/changedtick, invalidate on relevant events.

features.title: Mode, ruler and command feedback
features.scope: `'laststatus'`, `'ruler'`/`'rulerformat'`, `'showcmd'`/`'showcmdloc'`, `'showmode'`, `'shortmess'`, counts, pending operator display and `CTRL-G` file info.

features.title: Tabline layout and items
features.scope: Default tab labels, tab numbers, modified marker, `%1T` clickable tabs, `%X` close, `%#HL#`, `%{...}`, alignment/truncation, `'showtabline'`.

features.title: Statusline and tabline click actions
features.scope: Mouse press/double-click/wheel on statusline and tabline, semantic actions (focus window, close tab, scroll), `%[Func]` callback dispatch with `minwid`/`nclicks`/`button`/`mods`/`winid`/`area`/`tabnr`, `has('statusline_click')`, drag separation deferred to WIN-11.

features.title: GUI tabline hooks
features.scope: Metadata for native tab bars/tooltips/close buttons and drag reorder; design-only until a GUI backend exists.

features.title: Multi-line statusline
features.scope: `'statuslineopt'` `fixedheight`/`maxheight:N`, `%@` newlines, per-window statusline height, global-local option semantics, layout/cache/hit-region updates, interaction with `'laststatus'` and window resize.

features.title: Command-line state machine and editor
features.scope: `:`, `/`, `?` and `=` prompts; insert/overwrite, cursor motions, word/line kill, `<C-r>`, `<C-v>`, digraphs, `<C-f>`/`<C-b>`, history recall, prompt type.

features.title: Command-line history
features.scope: `'history'`, `:history`, `histadd()`/`histdel()`/`histget()`/`histnr()`, `@:` and `@@`, search history, duplicate suppression, persistence via BUF-15.

features.title: Command-line completion engine
features.scope: Context detection and all completion types: commands, files/dirs, buffers, tags, options, functions, variables, mappings, autocmds, highlights, syntax, compiler, environment; `getcompletion()`.

features.title: Wildmenu and popup completion
features.scope: `'wildmenu'`, `'wildmode'`, `'wildoptions'` (fuzzy, pum, tagfile), `'pumheight'`/`'pumwidth'`, `'pumopt'`/`'pumborder'` borders, match highlighting, `wildmenumode()`, cancel semantics.

features.title: Command-line window
features.scope: `q:`/`q/`/`q?`, `'cedit'`, `'cmdwinheight'`, execute on `<CR>`, cancel on `<C-c>`, editable history, `getcmdwintype()`.

features.title: Prompt functions and raw input
features.scope: `input()`/`inputlist()`/`inputsecret()`/`confirm()`, `getchar()`/`getcharstr()`/`getcharmod()`, mouse in prompts, cancel/timeout return values.

features.title: Search prompt and incremental search
features.scope: `'incsearch'`, `'hlsearch'`, search offsets, `<C-g>/<C-t>`, cancel restores view, `v:searchforward`, pattern delimiter and escaping.

features.title: Message pipeline
features.scope: `:echo`/`:echon`/`:echomsg`/`:echoerr`/`:echowindow`, message kinds and highlight groups, `v:statusmsg`/`v:errmsg`, expression-list echo, no message truncation of data.

features.title: Hit-enter and message history
features.scope: `'more'`, hit-enter prompt, `:messages` window, message ring buffer, `'cmdheight'`=0 behaviour and scrollback.

features.title: Capturing output
features.scope: `:redir` to variable/file/register, `execute()` capture, `:silent`/`:silent!`/`:unsilent`, `:filter`, ordering with nested commands.

features.title: Error formatting and throwpoints
features.scope: E-code registry, `v:errmsg`/`v:exception`/`v:throwpoint`, source/line context, `:verbose` suffix, translation lookup, `:silent!` suppression.

features.title: Intro, version and help output
features.scope: `:intro`, `:version`, `--version`, feature matrix, startup screen, `'shortmess'` flags, `:help`-less usage.

features.title: Dialogs and waits
features.scope: `:confirm`, `:browse` fallback, `:sleep` with interrupt, `confirm()` choices, dialog text without GUI dependency.

features.title: Normal-mode dispatch and counts
features.scope: Mode stack, counts, register prefix, operator-pending state, `v:count`/`v:count1`, ambiguous key resolution, error/beep policy, `<Esc>` cancellation.

features.title: Basic cursor motions
features.scope: `h j k l`, arrows, `<Space>`, `<BS>`, `+ - _ <CR>`, cursor clamping, counts, `'startofline'` interplay.

features.title: Word and WORD motions
features.scope: `w W b B e E ge gE` with `'iskeyword'`, counts, end-of-line crossing rules, multibyte correctness.

features.title: Line and column motions
features.scope: `0 ^ $ g_`, bar motion, `Home/End`, `g0/g^/g$/gm`, `gj/gk`, `'startofline'`, virtual columns and `curswant`.

features.title: Paragraph, sentence, section and bracket motions
features.scope: `{ } ( ) [[ ]] [] ][ [{ ]} [( ])`, `%` and `'matchpairs'`, `'paragraphs'`/`'sections'`, comments and preprocessor blocks.

features.title: Character search motions
features.scope: `f F t T ; ,`, counts, `'ignorecase'`? (char search is exact), repeat direction, multibyte character boundaries.

features.title: Search motions
features.scope: `/ ? n N * # g* g#`, `gn/gN`, `'wrapscan'`/`'ignorecase'`/`'smartcase'`, `'incsearch'`/`'hlsearch'`, search offsets, `v:searchforward`.

features.title: Marks, jumps and change positions
features.scope: Apostrophe and backtick mark motions, `[ ] < >` marks, `<C-o>/<C-i>`, `g;`/`g,`, `:jumps`/`:changes`/`:marks`, jump vs change list semantics.

features.title: Screen motions and scrolling keys
features.scope: `H M L`, `<C-e>/<C-y>`, `<C-d>/<C-u>`, `<C-f>/<C-b>`, `zz/zt/zb/z./z-/z+`, `'scroll'` and cursor keep.

features.title: Operator engine
features.scope: `d c y < > = ! gq gw g~ gu gU g? zf g@`, motion/text-object composition, counts, linewise/charwise/blockwise, register selection, abort/undo block.

features.title: Text objects
features.scope: `iw aw iW aW is as ip ap i( a( i[ a[ i{ a{ i< a< it at i` `a` `i'` `a'` `i"` `a"`, `ib/ab/iB/aB`, nesting, whitespace rules, block virtual edit.

features.title: Join and split lines
features.scope: `J`/`gJ`, `:join` with ranges, `'joinspaces'`, insert-mode newline, line splitting at cursor with indent preservation.

features.title: Replace and virtual replace

features.title: Visual modes
features.scope: `v/V/<C-v>`, `o/O` swap ends, `gv`, `:visual`, `'selection'`, blockwise virtual corners, visual marks `'<`/`'>`, mode messages.

features.title: Select mode and mouse selection
features.scope: `'selectmode'`, `'keymodel'`, select-mode entry keys, mouse drag, shift-selection, typing replaces selection.

features.title: Dot repeat and redo register
features.scope: `.` with counts, insert replay, operator replay, `".` register, `'report'`, changes that do not set dot, undo interaction.

features.title: Macros and `:normal`
features.scope: `q{reg}`, `@{reg}`/`@@`, counts, recursive macro abort, `:normal[!]` over ranges, register pollution rules, `q:` integration.

features.title: Increment and decrement
features.scope: `<C-a>/<C-x>`, `g<C-a>/g<C-x>` in Visual mode, `'nrformats'` (binary/octal/hex/alpha), leading zeros, overflow.

features.title: Case, shift, format and indent operators
features.scope: `~ g~ gu gU g?`, `>> <<`, `=`/`==`, `gq/gw`, `'formatoptions'`, `'textwidth'`, `'shiftwidth'`/`'expandtab'`/`'shiftround'`.

features.title: Virtual editing and wrap keys
features.scope: `'virtualedit'` (all/block/insert/onemore), `'whichwrap'`, `'keymodel'`, `'selection'`, cursor beyond EOL, tab/wide-char columns.

features.title: Change list
features.scope: `g;`/`g,`, `:changes`, change number preservation across edits, `getchangelist()`.

features.title: Paste mode and bracketed paste
features.scope: `'paste'`, `:set paste`, bracket-paste insertion without mappings/abbreviations/autoindent, paste register behaviour.

features.title: Custom operator `g@`
features.scope: `g@{motion}`, `'operatorfunc'`, `'[`/`']` marks, visual `g@`, errors and return to Normal mode.

features.title: Count display `g<C-g>`
features.scope: Selected lines/words/chars/bytes, visual block dimensions, Vim-compatible message.

features.title: Insert, append and open-line

features.title: Insert-mode special keys
features.scope: `<BS> <C-h> <C-w> <C-u> <C-t> <C-d> <C-e> <C-y> <C-r> <C-o> <C-v> <C-k> <C-@> <C-]>`, `'backspace'`, re-indent keys in `'cinkeys'`/`'indentkeys'`.

features.title: Digraphs

features.title: Abbreviations
